producers.instructions: Use a fresh isolated daemon/home/display :99. Set PASEO_NATIVE_QA to its private output directory and TSX_TSCONFIG_PATH=packages/app/tsconfig.json for TypeScript producers. Run fixture, prepare, proxy, expectations; use reference-dist from an unmodified Electron export. Copy scripts and the hashed native executable to that output directory. launch.py seeds dark/en and Noto Sans GTK settings. OS scripts assume a1280x800 native window at162,100, the selected fixture workspace, a retained terminal and320px Files dock; the semantic assertions fail if the setup differs. Run entrypoints then lifecycle then matched captures sequentially. Close clients, inspect retained PTY, then stop only the owned fixture/proxy/display.

limitations: Full Command Center root contributions, PR matching, plugins, multi-host/routed navigation, workspace/Agent subtitles/icons/status and recency parity remain pending. Root navigation is partial and not GUI-accepted by these file-search checks.

Full shortcuts/input-method/IME and custom appearance/localization matrix, request overload, actual30s timeout/disconnect/reconnect and mouse selection during a pending query are unaccepted. The model and bounded ownership code do not substitute for those interactions.
The UI-family resolver and RN default font stack can differ for other platform/settings combinations; the explicit Noto Sans fixture only accepts the recorded geometry comparison.
Mac/Windows are source-verified builds and six core tests each; GUI, IME, hardware rendering/latency/CPU/RSS, packaging and deployment remain unaccepted.
Complete desktop migration, Explorer panel host/tab persistence, terminal fidelity and original UI pixel parity remain incomplete.
